title: Sprint planning probes a query-log finding with pack --root _self before naming it off the kb's domains

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','how does sprint planning tell a query-log finding off the kb domains from a rules miss'],capture_output=True,text=True);ok=r.returncode==0 and 'coverage: good' in r.stdout;print('packs good:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Checks are planned when a sprint commits it (a tested _self question that packs good from the plan rule).
